run_depth_estimation_on_images: run MiDaS depth estimation on all images in an input folder and save depth maps to an output folder
run_depth_estimation_from_camera: run MiDaS depth estimation in real time from a webcam and display results in a window
process_inference_and_interpolate: process a single image through the MiDaS model and interpolate the prediction to the target size
create_side_by_side_depth_image: create a side by side image combining an RGB image and its normalized depth map with a colormap
run_depth_estimation_with_half_float_opt: run MiDaS depth estimation with half-float CUDA optimization for faster inference on supported models
